snippet.title: Ravenous Horde - Wishlist Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist the game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2179490/Ravenous_Horde/

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/jbx92tbMSG

Kill hordes of zombies as a hunter, and kill hunters when you're a zombie! In this round based multiplayer post-apocalyptic FPS you start as a hunter, and turn into a zombie when you die. Level up and unlock perks, new weapons and customization options!

Features:
- Asymmetrical 64 player PvP matches
- Create your own loadouts
- 50+ Perks to pick from as Hunter or Zombie
- Unlock weapons, weapon attachments, perks and customizations for your character
- Maps have different weather environments
- Great replayability
- Community and official hosted servers
